title: Completeness tested by the walking-isomorphism restriction
statement:
Use homotopy Segal spaces and their homotopy categories $hX$ from [lem-coef-segal-dk-diagonal-equivalence], and bisimplicial sets, vertical Reedy fibrancy and division notation from [lem-coef-bisimplicial-reedy-division-calculus]. Let $\mathcal J$ be the ordinary groupoid with objects $0,1$ and exactly one morphism between each ordered pair, and let $J=N\mathcal J$ be its ordinary nerve. Let $u_0:\Delta^0\hookrightarrow J$ select $0$. For every vertically Reedy fibrant homotopy Segal space $X$, completeness, meaning that $s_0:X_0\to X_{\mathrm{eq}}$ is a weak homotopy equivalence, is equivalent to the assertion that endpoint restriction
$$u_0\backslash X:J\backslash X\longrightarrow\Delta^0\backslash X=X_0$$
is a trivial Kan fibration. Here $X_{\mathrm{eq}}\subseteq X_1$ is the union of components representing isomorphisms in $hX$, and trivial Kan fibration has the meaning of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper].
